recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17660 unless Extension Pack governance later chooses to broaden designNote beyond the current Questionnaire and ElementDefinition contexts.
issue_request: FHIR-17660 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request asking to open the Questionnaire designNotes extension to other conformance resources. The accepted resolution was to rename the extension to designNote and add ElementDefinition to the extension context.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by eab6a853a7, which moved designNote from the Questionnaire extension spreadsheet into the general extension spreadsheet and added ElementDefinition to the context list. FHIR-13933 had introduced the original Questionnaire-scoped designNote extension.
additional_context: FHIR core later removed most extension definitions from the R5 source tree. The current core checkout retains the designNote OID and historical generated bundles but no active designNote source row. The current FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains StructureDefinition-designNote.xml in input/definitions/* with id/url designNote and contexts Questionnaire, Questionnaire.item, and ElementDefinition. The linked Zulip thread confirms the original rationale, and no conflicting Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative extension artifact already satisfies the FHIR-17660 resolution and reintroducing a core spreadsheet definition would be outside the current core build model.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the original Questionnaire designNote extension and explicitly asked for later feedback on expanding its contexts.
